Name: Event Launcher
Author: Knixel
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Writing events means playing them over and over. Normally that's a console command with an event ID you have to look up, and after every edit another round of [i]reload_i18n[/i], [i]patch reload[/i] and [i]debug ebi[/i]. Event Launcher turns that into one key.


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Event menu (F8):[/b] a searchable list of every event in the game, vanilla and modded. Search by event ID, location, or any text in the event script, like an NPC name or a line of dialogue. Events you've already seen are greyed out. Click an event, or press Enter for the top result, to play it.[/*]
[*][b]Replay (Shift + F8):[/b] plays the last event again.[/*]
[*][b]Reload and replay (F9):[/b] reloads your translations and Content Patcher packs, then plays the last event again, so you see your edits right away. Replaying after a reload can be turned off. Please be aware that depending on the amount of packs, this might take a while.[/*]
[*][b]Your own keys:[/b] change every key in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional). Each action has one key, and two actions can't share a key.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Please use a test save[/b][/size]
This mod plays events for real, the same way the game's own [i]debug ebi[/i] command does. Anything an event does happens to your save: friendship points, mail, flags, items, even a wedding. Make a copy of your save or use a separate test farm.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change keys in-game[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], for reloading content packs with F9[/color][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder and start the game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]. Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url] and Vortex.

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Use Generic Mod Config Menu, or edit [i]config.json[/i]:
[list]
[*][b]MenuKey[/b] (default F8): open or close the event menu[/*]
[*][b]ReplayKey[/b] (default LeftShift + F8): replay the last event[/*]
[*][b]ReloadKey[/b] (default F9): reload content[/*]
[*][b]ReplayAfterReload[/b] (default true): replay the last event after reloading[/*]
[*][b]ReloadPacks[/b] (default empty): Content Patcher pack IDs to reload. Leave empty to reload every pack. Only in config.json.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tested in single player. Multiplayer is currently not supported.[/*]
[*]F9 talks to SMAPI in a way SMAPI has no official option for. If a SMAPI update breaks it, the console shows an error and F8 and Shift + F8 keep working. Until there's a fix, type [i]reload_i18n[/i] and [i]patch reload[/i] in the SMAPI console yourself.[/*]
[*]Works well alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url] (see an event's requirements) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642]Event Repeater[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Doesn't change any game content, so it works with every other mod.
